Class WeatherSystem

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.world.WeatherSystem
public class WeatherSystem extends Object
Realistic Weather invalid input: '&' Atmospheric Physics Engine for SwarmForge. Features 12-month climate profiles, Perlin continuous micro-fluctuations, Markov Chain weather state transitions, Soil Thermal Inertia phase lag, Barometric pressure tendency, Hydric coupling, and In-Silico Eusocial Insect biological impact indicators.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
